title: Progression: Processor Route
summary: Plan the first processor worksite and route objective links to it.
body: This entry documents the prototype processor route only. Full machine recipes, balance, and art remain out of scope until Pack #2 graduates from the internal MVP. The 1.0.0 route proves that Terminal, MissionCore, HoloMap, Lens, and Index can agree on a processor worksite without hardcoding Foundry Protocol into Industrial Nexus.
